column1: # Ash Jenna's two fights: the optional super boss in Vale and the one at Suhalla Gate.

column3:
Vale hasn't changed.
I remember the roads.
I remember the faces.{page_break}I fought in another
world once, Isaac.
But this was my home.{end_wait}
You remember them.\nYou grew up here, too.\nWhy threaten them?{end_wait}

Because I know them.
I know which door
you'd run to first.{page_break}You think our past
will make me spare
a single one of them?{end_wait}

Still protecting them.
You haven't changed
at all, Isaac.{page_break}Go home. Your mother
is waiting for you.
I remember her, too.{end_wait}

The guards are hurt.
I didn't touch them.
I didn't have to.{page_break}Someone else did
the damage. And now
you're here with me.{end_wait}

You're using their pain
to get at me.
That's why you're here.{page_break}Move aside, Jenna.
We have to get
through the gate.{end_wait}

Good. You noticed.
Now fight me while
they lie there.{page_break}Every moment here
is one they won't
get back.{end_wait}

You won, Isaac.
Does that make you
feel like a hero?{page_break}Those men are still
waiting for help.
Go on. Hurry.{page_break}I hope you didn't
take too long.{end_wait}
I know your plan.\nIt won't work.

Idiots.
Did you think I'd miss
such a cheap trick?{page_break}Lean on tricks and
this is what you get.
